name: max_speed
effect: Maximum flight velocity; higher = faster traversal

name: max_angular_speed
effect: Max turn rate (rad/step); higher = tighter turns

name: drag
effect: Velocity decay per step; higher = slower movement

name: angular_drag
effect: Angular velocity decay; higher = turns damp faster

name: turn_gain
effect: L/R asymmetry → yaw rate; main chemotaxis responsiveness

name: tau
effect: Membrane time constant; higher = slower integration

name: threshold
effect: Spike threshold; lower = more active network

name: noise_std
effect: Membrane noise; higher = more random behavior

name: antenna_offset
effect: Bilateral antenna separation for L/R gradient

name: lh_motor_multiplier
effect: Injection strength to excitatory LH neurons

name: fruit_radius
effect: Visual size of fruit for loom calculation

name: loom_threshold
effect: Min loom rate to trigger landing

name: contact_radius
effect: Distance for tarsal contact with fruit

name: step_to_seconds
effect: Mapping of sim steps to wall-clock seconds

name: weight_threshold
effect: Min synapse weight for subgraph edges

name: wind_direction
effect: Wind flow direction (radians) for WIND type

name: advection_strength
effect: How much wind stretches odor plumes
